Sandbox_KnoxWildlifeSquirrel_Enabled: Squirrels: add them to the world
Sandbox_KnoxWildlifeSquirrel_Enabled_too: Grey squirrel: mature hardwood, wherever the mast is. Turn this off to leave squirrels out entirely: their routes are then not placed at all, and nothing else changes, because each species has its own target and none of them share a pool.
Sandbox_KnoxWildlifeSquirrel_Routes_tool: Multiplies this species' population, on top of Wildlife density. This is the setting that changes how many squirrels actually exist. Does nothing unless squirrels are turned on above.
Sandbox_KnoxWildlifeSquirrel_GroupSize_t: Multiplies the size of each squirrel group, on top of Group size. This does NOT change how many squirrels exist: the group count is divided to match, so you meet the same animals gathered into fewer, larger groups.
